contentHtml:
Renewing a UAE residence visa can be a complex process. Especially with recent updates to the rules and regulations. To avoid consequences, you must know how you can extend your stay.

If you’re a long-term resident, a new expatriate, or a family member on a dependent visa, the latest requirement understanding is essential. So that you can avoid any disruptions to your stay.

This blog explores the UAE residence visa renewal new rules. For instance, we are going to uncover:

  • Why it is necessary to renew a UAE residence visa?
  • What is the new rule for UAE residence visas?
  • Steps involved in renewing UAE residence visa

Why do individuals need to renew their UAE residence visa?

Individuals who are on their residence visa in the UAE need to renew it before its expiration. It is necessary to extend their stay and reside more in the UAE. If they fail to do so they may face consequences in the form of fines. So, don’t delay it and renew it before its expiration.

What is the new rule for UAE residence visas?

The UAE residents have a time of 30 days. It means they can renew it after the expiration date. This is an exciting chance to renew it even before your visa expires. Note that, we do not recommend that you wait until the last moment for renewal.

Renew your visa before the expiration date. In that case, get the required approval from the GDRFA.

Process of Residence Visa Renewal in UAE

The steps involved in the UAE residence visa renewal new rules are:

Prepare the Required Documents

Before starting out, gather all the necessary paperwork to avoid delays.

  • A recently colored personal photo with a white background
  • Copy of dependent’s passport
  • Emirates ID Application Receipt
  • Housing lease contract or proof of residence ownership
  • Copy of sponsor’s passport with a valid visa
  • Medical fitness certificate (for those above 18 years)

Undergo a Medical Test

The visa applicants above 18 undergo a medical test. They must prove that they are fit and free of contagious diseases. For renewing your residence visa in UAE, it is a mandatory test.

Apply for Emirates ID

You’ll need a renewed Emirates ID. After passing the medical test, submit your Emirates ID application.

Submit Application

Apply for the renewal either online via the ICP or GDRFA websites or visit an authorized typing center. You can also use smart apps like GDRFADUBAI or DUBAINOW.

Pay the Fees

Pay the applicable visa renewal fees. The fees vary depending on the visa type, but standard renewal costs apply.

Wait for Approval

On successful submission, your renewal will be processed. You’ll receive an updated residence visa sticker in your passport. If in case everything checks out smoothly.

Benefits of Residence Visa Renewal UAE

Several benefits of owning a residential visa in UAE. To avail of these benefits, renew it before it expires. Consider it a priority to renew your visa once the deadline is near. You can renew it easily by following the previous steps or with the help of Connect Freelance experts. Here are the benefits of visa renewal in UAE:

Bank Account or Loan

Visa renewal is a must if you want to open an account in the UAE for any purpose like saving or applying for a bank loan. Complete the official processes as soon as you can. You must have a minimum number of days of visa validity.

Government Healthcare and Insurance

Across the UAE, health insurance UAE is a must-have. In case of expiration, you won’t avail of any healthcare services. You’re not even eligible to get your health insurance. That’s why, it is recommended to update your visa to avoid any risky situations.

Visa-less travel to various countries

A residency visa in UAE allows you to travel to various countries in the Middle East. Even without a travel or tourist visa. But, you can’t travel to these countries if your visa has expired.

Obtaining a driver’s license

Applying for a driver’s license in UAE? Have a valid visa on your hand. Remember that, you can’t get your license if your visa expires during the process. So, keep an eye on the visa expiration date.

Your children can attend schools

Lastly, if you have a valid visa then it’s good for your children. Due to this, your children can attend public and private schools in UAE. We all know the quality education of in UAE. Various prestigious schools, colleges, and universities in the UAE provide the best education in the world.
